rationale: The strongest candidates contain familiar interagency-cooperation mechanisms, but none plausibly supplied the child's materially more specific drafting scheme. C07 combines agency cooperation with furnishing information and personnel services; C02 combines cooperation, information and assistance, and use of existing facilities and services; and C16 contemplates agency staff assistance. These are close in subject matter to the child's requests for loaned personnel, data, services, and facilities, but they are routine administrative formulations. None reproduces the child's distinctive structure: an urgent temporary staffing rationale, a presidential call under section 403, reimbursable personnel loans divided by expertise, detailed categories of economic data, and rapid notification of field offices.

shared_material.child_excerpt: each agency shall provide such cooperation and assistance, consonant with law, as it can
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Committee in its work
shared_material.explanation: C07 shares the standard direction that executive agencies cooperate, but this is routine interagency boilerplate.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Assignment of personnel ... [and] Furnishing any available reports, information, or other data
shared_material.parent_excerpt: to furnish the Committee such information or the services of such persons as the Committee may require
shared_material.explanation: C07 has the closest categorical overlap—both personnel services and information—but lacks the child's detailed temporary-loan and enforcement staffing machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Providing such other services, information, and facilities as may be appropriate
shared_material.parent_excerpt: to furnish the Administrator such information and Assistance as he may require ... utilize existing facilities and services
shared_material.explanation: C02 uses substantially similar generic categories, but only as a conventional cooperation clause rather than the child's concrete mobilization program.

shared_material.child_excerpt: make its resources in staff ... available to the Economic Stabilization Agency
shared_material.parent_excerpt: it may call upon other agencies for any special staff assistance which may be needed
shared_material.explanation: C16 parallels obtaining agency staff support, but it concerns assistance to a study commission and supplies no comparable operative sequence.
